# Wholesale Pause Letter 2025-10-06

The letter giving two weeks' notice to Pier Street Coffee and Lantern Books, sent by email and handed over on paper on 6 October 2025. Same text to both, with their names.

## Summary

- Supply paused from Monday 20 October 2025; last collection Saturday 18 October.
- Reason given: the oven failure in July, the hired oven, and the need to protect the shop's own bake and the early shift's hours.
- A "pause, not an end": we would review after the new oven and let them know first if we restart.
- Final invoice for October on 31 October.

## Why It Matters

It is the formal record of what we promised: to review, and to call them first. The review happened in November 2025 and the answer was no while baker hours were short ([[why-did-we-pause-wholesale-to-cafes]]). Nadia held me to the promise in May 2026 ([[wholesale-resumption-request-2026-05-12]]).

## Source Location

Email in the bakehouse mailbox, folder Wholesale; paper copy in the office folder "Wholesale".
